in_hebrew.name: אלידיר
in_hebrew.meaning: שם אנשי סלאח המסתמך על האל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלידיר הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו 'האל המאמין' או 'האל הנאמן'. נראה שהשם נלקט ממוצא יהודי-ערבי. בסורית ובארמית, שפות ששימשו לכתיבה תורנית, השם עוצב 'אליד'ר (אל-יד-ר) לייצג 'עזרה' או 'תמיכה'.

in_greek.name: Ἠλίδυρος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ Ἠλίδυρος εἶναι ὀνυμικόν τοῖς Ἕλλησι τοῦ ὀνόματος ἠλίδυρος, ὅς ἀπὸ τῶν ὀνομάτων εἰς ἑρμηνείαν ἐγείρεται. Ἡ λέξις ἠλίδυρος, ἔχουσα τὴν ἀρχαῖαν σημασίαν τοῦ θεοῦ, ἀπὸ τῆς ἑλληνικῆς ἐτυμολογίαν καταγίνεται καὶ ἐπὶ τοῦ ἑρμηνευτικοῦ ὀνόματος τοῦ θεοῦ, ὅς πιστεύεται. Τὸ ὀνομαστικὸν τοῦτο ἀπὸ τῆς ἑλληνικῆς ἐτυμολογίας ἐκφύεται καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ὀνομάτων τοῦ θεοῦ, ἀπὸ τῆς ἑλληνικῆς ἐπικῆς καὶ τῶν ὀνομαστικῶν τοῦ θεοῦ.

in_latin.name: Elidyr
in_latin.long_meaning: Elidyr, nomen Christianum, ex radicibus Hebraicis et Graecis derivatum, significat fidem vel fidelitatem Dei. In ecclesiis antiquis, nomen huius modi erat significativum fidei et devotionis Christianae. In contextu liturgico, Elidyr potest significare fidem et perseverantiam in fide Christi.

in_english.name: Elidyr
in_english.meaning: name of God the faithful or most faithful
in_english.long_meaning: Elidyr is a Christian name derived from Hebrew and Greek roots, meaning faith or fidelity to God. In ancient Christian churches, names of this type were significant of Christian faith and devotion. In liturgical context, Elidyr can signify faith and perseverance in the faith of Christ. Elidyr is also associated with virtues such as loyalty, dedication, and trust in God.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Elidyr" in Welsh means "the small one" or "the young one," which could have cultural implications as a name given to a child or a young person. It may also signify humility and respect for authority and elders in a traditional Welsh society.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual sense, the name "Elidyr" may represent the belief in God as the ultimate King or Ruler of all things. As the "small one," we, as individuals, are called to submit to God's divine will and rule with humility and obedience, recognizing our dependence on God's guidance and protection. The name may also symbolize hope and trust in God's faithfulness and provision for the future, echoing the Christian philosophy of God's sovereignty and love for his people.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Elidyr ap Iestyn was a 13th century Welsh poet. The name Elidyr carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
